d: Rajdhani patna ke paliganj thana kshetr ke kasopur ganv se ek dil dahla dene vali ghatna samne aaee hai. yahan andhvishvas aur jevar chori ke shak men ek mahila par apne hi devar ke 2 sal ke bete rishu urph rishabh ki berahmi se pitaee karne ka aarop laga hai, jiski ilaj ke dauran shukravar ko patna AIIMS men maut ho gaee. is ghatna ke bad pure ilake men kohram mach gaya hai aur pirit mata-pita ka ro-rokar bura hal hai.
